This class holds the attributes for a function, its return value, and its parameters.

detaileddescription.para: You access the attributes for each of them via an index into the AttributeList object. The function attributes are at index AttributeList::FunctionIndex, the return value is at index AttributeList::ReturnIndex, and the attributes for the parameters start at index AttributeList::FirstArgIndex.
